**Troubleshooting the Process**

Okay, it seems like the process isn't running. My first instinct, given my experience, is to try and pinpoint the issue quickly. I'll launch it in the foreground; that's the simplest way to get immediate feedback and see if any errors are thrown. If it doesn't start, or if there's a visible crash, that will give me valuable clues right away. If that's not informative, I'll need to immediately investigate the startup process and any relevant logs to determine why the automatic start-up failed. This will help determine if it is a startup issue or an execution issue.
